ns2:course.label: Asian American Ethnic Groups
ns2:course.description: Intensive interdisciplinary study of a particular Asian American ethnic group (specific ethnic group focus will change every semester). 3 undergraduate hours, 4 graduate hours. This course may be repeated up to a maximum of 9 undergraduate hours or 12 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Any AAS course at the 100 or 200 level or consent of instructor.
